A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ScaPre paper, with all 24 pages and Appendices A-D available. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical manuscript content except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C report original experiments on object, artistic-style and explicit-content unlearning, including quantitative benchmarks, robustness tests and component ablations.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C retain the same original benchmark, robustness and ablation results produced by the work.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same spectral trace regularizer, Informax Decoupler, Sylvester solution and geometry-alignment refinement. No algorithm component, objective or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Imagenette, ImageNet-Diversi50, ImageNet-Confuse5, 50 artistic styles, I2P and MSCOCO-30K, with the same adversarial test scenarios. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within every corresponding experiment. Main comparisons retain FMN, SPM, ESD, MACE, UCE, RECE and SP; the explicit-content comparisons in Tables 8-9 retain AC and their other existing comparators.

E3.justification: The Stable Diffusion versions, benchmark configurations, ResNet-50 evaluation, CLIP/FID/UQ metrics and testing procedures are identical. Appendix C.2 retains the same 4,703 I2P prompts and NudeNet confidence threshold of 0.6.

E4.justification: Both retain the same adversarial robustness tests, component ablations, quality-versus-concept-count analyses and alternative UQ normalizations. Tables 10 and 13-16 and Figures 11-12 contain identical analyses.

E5.justification: Both report the same point estimates and curves, without repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. The across-method standard deviations used for UQ normalization are also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical tables, plotted trends and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 reports ScaPre Imagenette Avg Acc of 0.8, CLIPcoco of 30.43 and UQ of 64.09 in both; all appendix result entries are likewise retained.

T1.justification: The objectives, definitions and mathematical reasoning in Sections 3-4 and Appendix B are identical, including the Sylvester solution and Bures/Procrustes derivations. Appendix C.7 also retains the same alternative UQ definitions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about scalability, precision, efficiency and training-free unlearning, including the claim of forgetting up to five times as many concepts within acceptable generative quality.

C2.justification: Explanations of update conflicts and concept disentanglement, interpretations of generative collapse and quality tradeoffs, and conclusions about adversarial robustness are unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures, RTX A6000 hardware information, runtime measurements, the ScaPre code link, the reproducibility statement and Appendix D baseline repository list are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list contain the same cited works and the same positioning relative to single-concept and multi-concept unlearning. Novelty claims are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2 dated 3 Apr 2026 to v4 dated 18 May 2026. This is a minor administrative text edit; manuscript wording, headings, section order and appendix structure are identical.

P2.justification: All 12 figures and 16 tables retain identical appearance, captions and placement. Rendered pages match except for the arXiv stamp text; no figure, table or document-layout revision is present.

improvement.justification: The complete scientific content, experimental evidence, derivations, explanations and reproducibility information are identical across both PDFs, including their appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in the paper's overall quality.
